ei.title: Don't Let Anger Be Your Boss

fullPassage: It is natural to feel angry from time to time; it doesn't mean there is something wrong with you. Anger can sometimes be a ① <u>useful</u> tool. For example, an angry but open conversation can ② <u>resolve</u> a conflict between friends. The important thing is to manage your anger so that it does not turn into aggressive or violent behavior. This does not mean that you should stop yourself from feeling angry. Rather, you should ③ <u>suppress</u> it in a productive way. Ask yourself some questions about your angry feelings. This can help you to better ④ <u>understand</u> your anger. You need to learn how to deal with anger in a socially ⑤ <u>appropriate</u> way.

questions.passage: Do you ever find yourself suddenly <u>ⓐ feeling</u> angry? One moment you're fine, and the next moment you're slamming doors or <u>ⓑ rolling</u> your eyes at your parents. Some people may think you just have a bad attitude or are getting too upset about a small problem. However, these feelings don't simply come from stress about everyday life. As a teen, you may feel like an adult, but your brain is still <u>ⓒ growing</u>. In your brain, there is a part that is responsible for <u>ⓓ solve</u> problems and controlling your emotions. The changes in your brain <u>ⓔ lead</u> you toward independence, social engagement, and creativity.

questions.passage: You need to learn how to deal with anger in a socially appropriate way. Remember: anger is a feeling, but behavior is a choice. The first step is <u>ⓐ recognizing</u> the physical signs of anger. It is possible to recognize <u>ⓑ those</u> signs in advance. They include an increased heart rate, a flushed face, and the clenching of your fists. When these things happen, take action to reduce your anger. Without the right coping skills, you may find yourself <u>ⓒ become</u> verbally or even physically aggressive. By <u>ⓓ developing</u> problem-solving skills, you will learn that there are many ways to solve a problem without getting angry.

questions.passage: In some cases, the strategies mentioned above may not be enough, so you may need to find proper coping skills for your personal situation. You can also try to find possible solutions to a problem and then compare the advantages and disadvantages of each one. questions.stem:
다음 <조건>과 <보기>를 참고하여 우리말을 영어로 옮기시오.

[우리말] 문제 해결 능력을 기름으로써, 너는 화내지 않고 문제를 해결하는 많은 방법이 있다는 것을 배울 것이다.

[조건] <보기>의 단어를 모두 활용하여 한 문장으로 쓸 것 / 필요시 단어의 형태를 변형할 것

[보기] develop / problem-solving / learn / many / solve / without / angry

det.korean: 문제 해결 능력을 기름으로써 화내지 않고 문제를 해결하는 많은 방법이 있다는 것을 배울 것이다.
det.analysis: 원문: By developing problem-solving skills, you will learn that there are many ways to solve a problem without getting angry.
det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: As a teen, you may feel like an adult, but your brain is still growing. You may also be more sensitive to unfairness. Furthermore, your body is flowing with hormones. This significantly affects your mood. The combination of these factors intensifies your strong emotions.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 형태로 고쳐 쓰시오.

The combination of these factors ( intense ) your strong emotions.

det.korean: 이러한 요인들의 결합이 강한 감정을 강화한다. 주어 The combination(단수) + 3인칭 단수 현재 동사 intensifies.
det.analysis: 원문: The combination of these factors intensifies your strong emotions.
det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.
